name: REYcomp INC

about:
REYcomp INC, based in Grand Prairie, Texas, was founded in 2001. The company is led by CEO Georg Rey.

The company provides electronic assembly services including surface-mount (SMT) and through-hole (TH) PCB assembly, wire harness fabrication, box build, and panel assembly. It also offers PCB repair, parts procurement, first-article inspection (FAI), and country-of-origin (COO) management. Production uses Siemens SMT machines capable of placing components from QFB and BGA down to µBGA, CBDA, CSP, and flip-chip packages. REYcomp employs cellular manufacturing, single-piece flow, standardized work, and pull systems to reduce lead times and inventory.

The company serves customers requiring electronic assembly and repair services across various industries, though specific verticals are not disclosed in its public materials.

REYcomp emphasizes personalized customer support and quick-turn capabilities, with CEO Georg Rey noting that engineering changes are addressed directly without bureaucratic delays. The firm focuses on building one-on-one partnerships to deliver products on schedule at a competitive cost-performance ratio.
